blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tropical forests display strong vertical stratification due to intense competition for sunlight.
The Emergent Layer features trees above 50 meters exposed to strong winds.
The Canopy serves as a dense leafy roof that holds most of the wildlife.
The Understory is composed primarily of shade-tolerant plants.
The Forest Floor features rapid decomposition driven by high warmth and humidity.

rows: Rapid decomposition due to warmth and humidity

items: Emergent layer trees reach heights above 50 meters and face strong winds.
